title: Litter-Robot Cycle Gap
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=litterrobot:cycle
| stats max(_time) as last_cycle by device
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_cycle)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Litter-Robot cycle data telemetry to monitor how long it has been since the box last cycled in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for maintenance or power issues before the box becomes unusable, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Litter-Robot cycle data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Device table of hours since last cycle.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long it has been since the box last cycled so you can spot maintenance or power issues before the box becomes unusable before it becomes annoying.
